categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in comprehensive construction services including civil engineering, dredging, piping, interior decoration, and specialized construction such as bridges, tunnels, and rail transit systems. It also engages in manufacturing related to ready-mixed concrete, cement, and transportation equipment parts, as well as real estate development and leasing. The business focuses mainly on public infrastructure projects with supplementary private sector and overseas construction activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction technologies such as prestressed beam pushing and hoisting, cast-in-place cantilever pushing, precast U-beam hoisting, and cable-stayed bridge construction methods. It integrates BIM (Building Information Modeling) for project planning and quality control, and applies PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) cycles for process improvement. The firm also emphasizes automation, standardization, and safety in construction, with ongoing R&D in specialized construction techniques like damping systems and steel bridge segment transportation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies responsible for public infrastructure, including transportation departments, power companies, port authorities, and military units. The company serves public sector projects such as highways, railways, bridges, tunnels, ports, and metro systems, with some engagement in private construction and overseas markets. Major clients include Taiwan's Ministry of Transportation, Taiwan Power Company, Taiwan Railways Administration, and various municipal governments.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily within Taiwan, covering northern, central, and southern regions, with active participation in eastern Taiwan development projects. The company also plans to expand into overseas markets, leveraging international partnerships and government initiatives to pursue infrastructure projects abroad, particularly in New Southbound countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly as a midstream construction contractor, responsible for project execution including procurement of materials and subcontracting. It sources major construction materials domestically and some specialized materials internationally, maintaining stable supply chain relationships. It also collaborates with upstream engineering consultants and downstream clients such as government agencies and private developers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include sustainable development, cost control, employee motivation, talent cultivation, standardization, and safety/environmental management. R&D focuses on integrating BIM technology, developing innovative construction methods, and enhancing automation and digitalization of construction management. The company aims to strengthen technical capabilities through domestic and international cooperation and to expand into green energy and building sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through contract-based project execution for public and private construction works. The company earns income from engineering contracts, including civil, marine, bridge, tunnel, and rail transit projects. Additional revenue streams include real estate sales and leasing, as well as manufacturing and wholesale of construction materials and machinery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major Taiwanese construction firms such as China Engineering, Hsin Lu Engineering, Jianguo Construction, Genji Construction, Huang Chang Construction, and Daxin Engineering. It holds a competitive position as a large-scale comprehensive construction contractor with expertise in public infrastructure and specialized engineering, leveraging advanced technologies and strong government relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenues of approximately NT$7.1 billion in the latest fiscal year, with a slight net profit after tax. Total assets increased by 38% year-over-year, reflecting growth in project scale and prepayments. Despite increased operating expenses and litigation-related costs impacting profitability, the company maintains stable equity and cash flow, supported by substantial government infrastructure investments and a diversified project portfolio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its extensive experience in major public infrastructure projects, advanced construction technologies, and integration of BIM for quality and efficiency. It differentiates through specialized construction methods, strong safety and environmental management, and a commitment to sustainable development. Its ability to form strategic alliances and adapt to evolving market and regulatory environments enhances its competitive edge.
